reading.title: What Is the Weather Today?
reading.purpose: Hear a child and Dad talk about the weather.
paras: Jo asks, "What is the weather?" Dad says, "It is foggy and chilly."
Jo asks, "Is a storm here?" Dad says, "No. It is a soft breeze." Jo pats the grass. It is damp. Jo grabs a warm hat. "Fog is fun!" says Jo.

qs.q: Dad says it is only a breeze. What is a breeze?
qs.why: A breeze is a soft, gentle wind, not a storm.
Jo pats the grass, and the reading says it is damp.

qs.q: Why does Jo grab a warm hat?
qs.why: Dad said it is chilly, so a warm hat is a good idea.
